summary: Frontend interview practice in progress. Event loop/async scheduling cluster is Senior-ready: candidate correctly reasons about Promise chaining, async/await suspension, task vs microtask checkpoints, microtask starvation, time slicing, responsiveness vs throughput, and Web Worker trade-offs. React cluster started. Candidate correctly identified that React.memo child still re-renders when parent recreates an object prop because shallow prop comparison sees a new reference, and correctly avoided reflexively adding useMemo for a cheap child without evidence of a performance problem. Next React follow-up should probe memoization boundaries, reference stability, state ownership, and when optimization is justified.
